zones.title: From the pavement
zones.intro: Corbridge Court is a brick block on Glaisher Street, with the entrance on the ground floor at the corner. A purple A-board stands on the pavement beside the door.

shots.caption: The ground-floor entrance at the corner of Corbridge Court.
shots.alt: A four-storey brick building seen from the pavement, with a white ground-floor corner entrance and a small purple A-board standing beside the door.

zones.title: Reception and waiting
zones.intro: Past the entrance is a reception and waiting area with chairs. The way through to the treatment room is the doorway on the right.

shots.caption: The reception and waiting area inside the entrance.
shots.alt: A bright reception area with a pale blue front desk, a white orchid on the counter, white chairs and a tiled floor, and a doorway leading off to the right.

zones.title: The room by day
zones.intro: One bed, a wall unit with a worktop, a chair and framed pictures, seen here in daylight.

shots.caption: The bed, the wall unit and the pictures by day.
shots.alt: A treatment room with a bed made up in white paper with a purple towel, a white wall unit and worktop beside a cushioned chair, and framed pictures on the wall.

shots.caption: The chair and the end of the bed, in daylight.
shots.alt: A treatment-room corner with a purple towel over the end of the bed, a folding chair with a blue cushion, white cupboards and two framed pictures.

shots.caption: The bed against the patterned curtain, with framed certificates on the wall.
shots.alt: A single bed with white paper and a purple pillow towel beside a wall of patterned sheer curtain, with a row of framed certificates on the white wall above.

zones.title: The same room, lights low
zones.intro: With the main lights off, the room is lit by candles and a few small coloured lamps.

shots.caption: The wall unit, with candles, coloured lamps and small figures on top.
shots.alt: A white wall unit with tiny lights and small Buddha figures along the top, and teal and pink lamps glowing on the worktop below.

shots.caption: The bed in candlelight, with a framed picture of candles behind.
shots.alt: A dimly lit corner of the room with a bed in the foreground, a framed picture of candles and stones on the wall and a warm glow low beside the bed.

shots.caption: The bed and the wall unit with the lights low.
shots.alt: A dim room with the bed in the foreground, a wall clock on the pale wall and a white cabinet with small candles on top in the far corner.

zones.title: Small touches
zones.intro: Flowers, framed pictures, candles and lamps around the room.

shots.caption: A corner with a chair, pink flowers and framed pictures.
shots.alt: A white chair with a blue patterned cushion beside a worktop with pink flowers in a vase, below two framed pictures, with a candle glowing low on the right.

shots.caption: Candles, a blue lamp and small figures along the wall unit.
shots.alt: A white wall unit with candles and small figures along the top, and a bright blue lamp glowing on the worktop beneath it.
